instructions:
Look at the following statements and the list of wheat types below.

Match each statement with the correct type, A-E.
Write the correct letter, A-E, in boxes 23-26 on your answer sheet.

NB You may use any letter more than once.

items.prompt: Grain shape alone had placed both of the main samples among wheats of this kind before any DNA was read.
items.evidence: The two main samples analysed had originally been classified, from their shape alone, as einkorn and emmer, both simpler wheats.
items.feature_check: Karistirilabilecek ogeler B ve C: ayni cumle iki ornegi einkorn ve emmer diye tek tek adlandirdigi icin iki secenek de dogruymus gibi duruyor. Ama ifade IKI ornegi birden ayni kumeye koyuyor; pasajin o kumeye verdigi ortak nitelik B/2'de duruyor -- basit bugdaylar iki ya da dort takim kromozom tasir. Yani D'yi secmek icin iki cumleyi (E/1 ve B/2) birlestirmek gerekiyor, secenegin sozu tek basina yetmiyor. A ve E elenir: ikisi de tane bicimine degil, DNA okunduktan sonra cikan sonuclara bagli (A icin B/2 ve G/3, E icin F/2).
items.explanation: Paragraph E says the two main samples had originally been classified, from their shape alone, as einkorn and emmer, both simpler wheats; paragraph B states that such simpler wheats carry two or four sets of chromosomes.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Grain shape alone had placed both of the main samples among wheats of this kind before any DNA was read.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: The two main samples analysed had originally been classified, from their shape alone, as einkorn and emmer, both simpler wheats.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Secenegin metni cevabi adlandiriyordu: 'the simpler wheats' ifadesi kanit cumlesindeki 'both simpler wheats' ile birebir ayni sozcugu tasiyor, dolayisiyla dogru secenek pasaja bakilmadan da bir kume adi olarak taniniyordu (E7 3/3, dayanak option_wording).
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Secenekten ad kaldirildi: D artik 'the two- and four-chromosome wheats'. Ayrim yalniz pasaj ayrintisiyla kaldi -- adayin E/1'den iki ornegin ortak kumeye konuldugunu, B/2'den de o kumenin kac takim kromozom tasidigini okumasi gerekiyor. Kanit cumlesi ve cevap harfi degismedi.

items.prompt: The researchers are prepared to describe the presence of this type in the Neolithic Near East only as a possibility.
items.evidence: The researchers interpret this as evidence of an early, transitional stage in the cultivation of hexaploid wheat, and note that this is the first genetic evidence hinting at the presence of a spelt-like wheat in the Neolithic Near East at all, a possibility they treat cautiously given how limited the surviving evidence is.
items.feature_check: Karistirilabilecek oge A: calismanin manseti hexaploid bugdayin beklenenden erken gorulmesi, o yuzden 'ihtiyatla ele alinan bulgu' kaydi sezgisel olarak ona yakisiyor. Ama F/2 ihtiyat kaydini acikca spelt benzeri bugdayin varligina bagliyor ('a possibility they treat cautiously'); hexaploid icin ayni cumlede soylenen sey ihtiyat degil, erken gecis asamasi yorumu. B, C ve D elenir: basit bugdaylarin Neolitik Yakin Dogu'da bulunmasi zaten beklenen durum, pasaj onlar icin ne bir ilk ne de bir ihtiyat kaydi tutuyor.
items.explanation: Paragraph F says the presence of a spelt-like wheat in the Neolithic Near East is a possibility the researchers treat cautiously, given how limited the surviving evidence is.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: The team's evidence is put forward, cautiously, as the first genetic sign that a wheat of this kind was present in the Neolithic Near East.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: The researchers interpret this as evidence of an early, transitional stage in the cultivation of hexaploid wheat, and note that this is the first genetic evidence hinting at the presence of a spelt-like wheat in the Neolithic Near East at all, a possibility they treat cautiously given how limited the surviving evidence is.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Ifade 'ilk genetik isaret' cercevesindeydi ve bes secenek arasinda bir 'ilk'in ancak beklenmedik/nadir ture ait olabilecegi salt mantikla cikiyordu; aday listeye bakip en egzotik secenegi isaretliyordu (E7 3/3, dayanak logic).
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Eksen 'ilk olma'dan 'arastirmacinin kipi'ne cevrildi: hangi tur icin yalnizca bir OLASILIK dendigi soruluyor. Sezgi artik YANLIS secenege capali, cunku calismanin carpici bulgusu hexaploid (A) ve ihtiyatli kip ona yakisiyor gorunuyor; dogru cevap ancak F/2'nin son yan cumlesi okununca cikiyor. Kanit cumlesi ve cevap harfi korundu, kalem F/2'de tek soru olarak kaldi.

items.prompt: Under magnification, some of the charred grains had looked as though they were this type.
items.evidence: Some of these seeds looked, under the microscope, as though they belonged to hexaploid wheat, a genetically more complex form carrying six sets of chromosomes rather than the two or four sets typical of the simpler wheats usually associated with the earliest stages of farming.
items.feature_check: Karistirilabilecek ogeler B, C ve D: bicime bakan siniflandirma iki ana ornegi basit bugdaylara koydugu icin (E/1) aday mikroskop altindaki gorunumu de o tarafa baglayabilir -- ustelik 23. soru tam olarak bunu soyluyor. Ayrim B/2'de: bazi taneler mikroskop altinda alti kromozom takimi tasiyan daha karmasik forma ait gibi durmus, basit bugdaylar ise iki ya da dort takim tasiyor. E elenir, cunku spelt adi ancak modern turlerle karsilastirmadan sonra, F paragrafinda geciyor; mikroskop asamasinda boyle bir ad hic anilmiyor.
items.explanation: Paragraph B says that under the microscope some of the charred seeds looked as though they belonged to hexaploid wheat, a form carrying six sets of chromosomes.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: One simple wheat in particular is usually said to have first been brought into cultivation here.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Simple wheat domestication is usually traced to the Fertile Crescent around twelve thousand years ago, with the region of Karacadağ in southern Turkey generally credited as the birthplace of einkorn cultivation specifically.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Sorunun ekseni arkeoloji genel bilgisi: Karacadag'in einkorn ekiminin dogdugu yer olarak anilmasi, ayni kanit cumlesinde duran ve alanin disindan da bilinen spesifik bir bilgi. Kanit cumlesi degismeden ifadenin dayanabilecegi baska bir ayrinti yok.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Eski soru da G/2'ye dayaniyordu: Karacadag'in einkorn ekiminin dogdugu yer olarak anilmasi. Bu, alan disindan da bilinen spesifik bir arkeoloji bilgisi. Yeni kanit B/2'ye tasindi ve eksen bir yer iddiasindan tane gorunumune gecti: tanelerin mikroskop altinda hangi forma benzedigi disaridan bilinemez. Kip: ifade olculu ('some', 'as though').

items.prompt: The settlement is put forward as a possible staging point on this type's spread towards Europe.
items.evidence: Finding genetic traces of hexaploid wheat at Çatalhöyük this early suggests that the more advanced, six-chromosome form of wheat may have emerged sooner, and further from the traditional Fertile Crescent core, than researchers had assumed, with Çatalhöyük potentially serving as a staging point on its spread toward Europe.
items.feature_check: Karistirilabilecek oge D: tarimin Bereketli Hilal'den Avrupa'ya yayilmasi anlatisi her zaman basit bugdaylar uzerinden kurulur ve A/3 de yerlesimin 'tarim uygulamalarini' Avrupa'ya tasiyan yollar uzerinde durdugunu soyler; bu yuzden sezgi iki-dort takim kromozomlu bugdaylara gidiyor. Ama G/3'te Avrupa'ya dogru yayilan sey acikca alti kromozomlu form: 'its spread' zamiri o cumlenin oznesine bagli. B ve C elenir: einkorn ve emmer G paragrafinda yalnizca standart anlatinin parcasi olarak aniliyor, yayilma iddiasinin oznesi degiller. E elenir: spelt yalniz F paragrafinda, benzerlik baglaminda geciyor.
items.explanation: Paragraph G says that finding genetic traces of hexaploid wheat at the site this early suggests the six-chromosome form emerged sooner and further from the traditional core than assumed, with the settlement potentially serving as a staging point on its spread toward Europe.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: The sequences recovered from the settlement suggest this form may have arisen earlier, and further from the usual heartland, than researchers had thought.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Finding genetic traces of hexaploid wheat at Çatalhöyük this early suggests that the more advanced, six-chromosome form of wheat may have emerged sooner, and further from the traditional Fertile Crescent core, than researchers had assumed, with Çatalhöyük potentially serving as a staging point on its spread toward Europe.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Ifade 'beklenenden erken ve cekirdek bolgeden uzakta ortaya cikmis olabilir' diyordu; bes secenek icinde 'sasirtici olan' tek aday ileri/karmasik form oldugu icin cevap salt mantikla, pasaj okunmadan seciliyordu (E7 3/3, dayanak logic).
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Eksen 'sasirticilik'tan yayilma yonune cevrildi ve sezgi YANLIS secenege capalandi: tarimin Avrupa'ya yayilmasi anlatisi genel kulturde basit bugdaylarla anilir (secenek D), oysa G/3'te Avrupa'ya dogru yayilan sey alti kromozomlu form. Ayrica secenek D'nin 'simpler' sozcugu kaldirildigi icin liste artik 'basit / ileri' diye siralanip mantikla cozulemiyor.
